name: Achior
description: Captain of all the sons of Ammon in Holofernes' army; when asked by Holofernes told him the true history of Israel and warned that their God would defend them unless they sinned, for which the chief men wished to kill him; Holofernes had him bound and left for the Israelites, who loosed him and brought him to Bethulia before the governors; after Judith slew Holofernes, Achior was sent for, saw the head, believed in the God of Israel, was circumcised, and was joined to the house of Israel from that day

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
